relationships.evidence: For the machine reading comprehension task, we evaluate the models’ performance by fine-tuning them on the Chinese CMRC dataset (Cui et al., 2019) and English SQuAD dataset (Rajpurkar, 2016), followed by zero-shot testing on the TibetanQA dataset (Sun et al., 2021) to assess their cross-lingual transfer capabilities (Section 4.3).
